cases.input: Three work items are reprioritized without changing their tracker state.
cases.expect: A successor backlog revision records the new order while WorkItems remain unchanged.

cases.input: One item leaves the backlog after a planning decision.
cases.expect: The new revision omits it and prior membership remains resolvable.

cases.input: One WorkItem is referenced by two governed backlogs with different purposes.
cases.expect: Each backlog owns its membership and rank while the WorkItem keeps one identity.

cases.input: Global rank is written directly onto the WorkItem and reused in every backlog.
cases.expect: The update is rejected because rank is backlog-revision scoped.

cases.input: A frozen backlog revision is edited in place.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected and a successor revision is required.

cases.input: A tracker board automatically creates a Project identity.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected until an authoritative project mapping exists.

cases.input: Removing membership deletes the WorkItem and its history.
cases.expect: The deletion is rejected because membership and WorkItem have separate masters.
